item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 03/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. The weather will be generally fine, and warm during the day over the region. A band of clouds will cover the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong towards the weekend and early next week. There will be a few showers over the region. Winds are expected to be weak over Guangdong midweek next week. It will be rather warm during the day with coastal mist in the morning and at night.

Wind: East to northeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: Fine. Cool in the morning. Warm and very dry during the day.
Temp range: 17 - 25 C
R.H. range: 35 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low
